title: Card
summary: A titled panel with optional media, header actions and footer. Vertical or horizontal (stacking by its own width), flush for tables, and optionally one link.

props.name: heading
props.description: The card title. Without it (and without actions) the header is not shown.

props.name: level
props.description: The heading level the title exposes to assistive technology (aria-level).

props.name: tone
props.description: error draws the border in the error colour.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Horizontal puts the media beside the content; it stacks when the card is narrower than 30rem (a container query, not the viewport).

props.name: flush
props.description: No padding around the body, for a table or an edge-to-edge body; the heading row keeps its padding.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the whole card one link (a single tab stop named by the heading).

props.name: fill
props.description: Fills a flex parent (a workspace pane): the card takes the remaining height, has no padding, and its body is the scroll region.

props.name: state
props.description: Which body shows. ready shows the slotted content; loading, empty and error hide it and draw the matching built-in state (a labelled skeleton, pk-empty-state, a danger pk-alert) in its place. The heading, actions, footer and media are unchanged in every state. For error, set the retry callback property (business logic, never an attribute, called with no arguments) to show a Retry action.

props.name: stateHeading
props.description: Heading of the empty or error state (the loading skeleton uses it as its label). Sensible defaults apply when empty.

props.name: stateDescription
props.description: Explanation shown under the empty or error state heading.

slots.name: media
slots.description: An image, picture or video at the top (or the start when horizontal).

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Buttons or links at the right of the header.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Content below the body; hidden when empty.

parts.name: state
parts.description: The loading, empty or error state; shown instead of the body when state is not ready.

parts.name: media
parts.description: The media wrapper; hidden when empty.

parts.name: content
parts.description: The padded content column (header, body, footer).

parts.name: link
parts.description: The overlay link when href is set.

cssProperties.name: --pk-card-media-width
cssProperties.description: Media width in the horizontal layout.

a11y: The title is exposed as a heading whose level you choose with level, so the card fits the page outline wherever it sits. With href the card holds one link named by the heading, so there is a single tab stop and no nested interactive content. A loading state is announced by its pk-skeleton and an error by its pk-alert, so the card adds no live region of its own.
